The proof verifies quantifiers for all integers n>=5 over C. The exact-arithmetic checker supports numerical cases without substituting for proof.

value.rationale: The generic degree is the number of rank-two Hankel completions from a natural sparse four-observation pattern, an enumerative invariant central to the cited low-rank completion problem. The result resolves the exact degree for all n where the source had only a finite table and a nonsharp bound; two intrinsic pole orders give a structural geometric explanation and demonstrate an asymptotic gap from the prior bound.
